name: meminfo
title: SDRAM usage panel (debug)
summary: Debug, read-only: shift + speech cycles a full-screen panel: SDRAM size (memory controller), TE's heap (used, peak, free, largest free block), and a map of which 64 KB chunks of SDRAM change over time (scan starts at the first opening, only reads memory the CPU's data CPLBs cover); page 2 lists the data CPLBs. Nothing outside its own variables is written.
controls: shift + speech: off -> map -> CPLBs -> off (the first opening starts the scan)
